# Gadfly — User Stories
> ✅ done (shipped & tested) · 🟡 partial · ⬜ planned. Every ✅ cites the test.

## Priority backlog
_Nothing recorded yet._


## Epic SA — Socratic platform: foundation
- **GAD-US-SA1 ⬜** As MindAttic, Gadfly is a reusable Socratic engine any app can embed, with today's personal introspection tool as one consumer of it.


## Epic SB — Socratic platform: the engine
- **GAD-US-SB1 ⬜** As an examiner, I can run an adaptive Socratic exam that probes a student's understanding of each concept, confronts contradictions in their own claims, and stops at mastery, aporia or the time budget.
- **GAD-US-SB2 ⬜** As an instructor, I get a per-concept report with quoted evidence, source citations and the judges' dissent, as a recommendation I finalize.


## Epic SC — Socratic platform: source material and grounding
- **GAD-US-SC1 ⬜** As an instructor, I upload my own source material and get an editable concept map and rubric that every question and judgment is grounded in, with citations.


## Epic SD — Socratic platform: hosted server and API
- **GAD-US-SD1 ⬜** As the platform, every live session runs server-side with its turns, judgments and events persisted in SQL Server, resumable after a disconnect.
- **GAD-US-SD2 ⬜** As a third-party app, I can create exams, launch sessions in an embedded room and receive results through a keyed API and webhooks.


## Epic SF — Socratic platform: customer and student accounts
- **GAD-US-SF1 ⬜** As a customer org admin, I invite instructors and students into my organization, each with a role, and nobody ever sees another organization's data.


## Epic SG — Socratic platform: exam web app
- **GAD-US-SG1 ⬜** As a student, I check my mic and camera, consent, and take a spoken exam with a talking examiner that listens and follows up on what I said.
- **GAD-US-SG2 ⬜** As an instructor, I build exams from my sources, assign them, review each session's transcript, scores and evidence, and finalize the grade.


## Epic SI — Socratic platform: integrity
- **GAD-US-SI1 ⬜** As an instructor, I see integrity evidence (faces, voices, off-screen reading, focus loss, answer cadence) explained on the session timeline, with no automated accusation and no deception or emotion inference.


## Epic SP — Socratic platform: production and pilot
- **GAD-US-SP1 ⬜** As MindAttic, the platform runs on Azure with consent, retention, security and cost controls, and has been piloted with Erin's real exams.


## Epic MP — Master plan MVP: Socratic assessment with human-AI grading
- **GAD-US-MP1 ⬜** As an institution, I run adaptive Socratic examinations whose every response is verified and preserved, scored by AI per learning objective and independently by a human, reconciled when they disagree, combined by an approved weighting policy, and released only after authorized approval (docs/MASTER-PLAN.md).

| GAD-T73 | 2026-11-20 | fix | closed | HttpTenantContext reports IsSystem=true whenever IHttpContextAccessor.HttpContext is null, which turns off the tenant query filter and the write guard. Inside an interactive Blazor Server circuit HttpContext is not guaranteed (null on long-polling/SSE transports, timers, background continuations), so component queries could run unfiltered. Pin the tenant at circuit start from the AuthenticationStateProvider, fall back to 'no tenant' (sees nothing) instead of system, and make system an explicit opt-in for background scopes (GAD-T64 security review). | 77e3c46 |
| GAD-T74 | 2026-11-20 | fix | closed | SessionOrchestrator's live-session cache only compared the organization, so any student in the same organization who knew a session id could read its question, answer into it or end it via the hub/exam room before the ownership check in PersistAsync ran (the in-memory engine was already changed). Check the student on the cached path and before broadcasting Thinking (GAD-T64 security review). | 5c3df94 |
| GAD-T75 | 2026-11-20 | fix | closed | Webhook URLs only had to be https, so an org admin or API key could point deliveries at localhost, private ranges, link-local/metadata addresses or internal hostnames (blind SSRF with the response code shown as an oracle; redirects followed). Refuse non-public targets at registration and at connect time (DNS-rebinding safe) and stop following redirects (GAD-T64 security review). | dbc4c17 |
| GAD-T76 | 2026-11-20 | fix | closed | Organization memberships ride on the sign-in cookie, so removing a member or changing their role only took effect at their next sign-in, and an Admin could demote or deactivate an Owner (and so leave the organization ownerless). Rotate the account's security stamp on role/active changes so live sessions and circuits revalidate within a minute, and only an Owner may change an Owner or grant Owner (GAD-T64 security review). | e401ab1 |

earlier answered turns are backfilled as Captured originals by a startup service (AddVerification) (GAD-T86); 69b12b8 Demo tour (Gadfly.Tour): starts a real Gadfly.Server under a renamed exe in mock (or --live) mode against a throwaway LocalDB database (--fresh), seeds the demo, and drives the workflow as real users over HTTP, the platform API and the SessionHub (antiforgery sign-in for every role, MOCK banner, access control, teacher setup, API source processing, student exam with good/ambiguous/typo/revision/I-don't-know answers, end and report, mock labelling, AI and human grading, approval, appeal, report export, review, API results, analytics, audit); a111a80 Response analysis and evidence collection: every answer gets a panel analysis (claims, misconceptions per objective, uncertainties, evidence for/against each objective with its Part 5.1 dimension, whether the question revealed the answer), each reply validated strictly against the schema (exact keys, types, enums, known objectives; malformed replies rejected with the reason recorded), items whose quote is not the student's own words dropped, the rest merged by majority; analysis claims feed the claim ledger; an honest "I don't know" is analysed deterministically; SourceExamEngine exposes Objectives, Assessments(), CollectEvidence(), FlagLeak() and CheckClarificationAsync(); EvidenceWriter maps the engine's evidence to AssessmentEvidence rows linked to the verified response and its latest transcript version (verbatim-quote and verified-state checks, idempotent, contamination/assistance flags only turn on, audited) (GAD-T91); 92f679a Questioning strategies A-H: CausalReasoning, ScenarioVariation, AssumptionTesting and IndependentExplanation join conceptual probing, counterexample, transfer and contradiction; the planner picks by information value (the move whose answer best separates the corroborated level, the tentative top and the plausible ceiling, with misconception, dimension-gap, repetition and difficulty terms) and records why; the question prompt (ExamPromptsV3, merged as the next prompt-set version until folded into ExamPrompts) describes all eight and forbids teaching in examination mode; Learning Mode hints and guided explanations get their own prompt; the leak guard fails closed (undecided -> safe fallback) and is reusable on clarifications; drafts that are only a move name or talk about the student are not asked (GAD-T90); 14bc148 Objective-driven examination control: the engine examines learning objectives (key, title, grounding concepts, rubric criteria/dimensions; one implicit objective per concept when an exam has none); per objective a deterministic assessor tracks corroboration (a level needs 2+ independent supporting answers, a conclusion 2+ independent answers), consistency (unconfronted or failed contradictions), transfer and critical reasoning shown, untested misconceptions and remaining uncertainty, and closes it as Sufficient or Inconclusive (per-objective question limit, time with the accommodations multiplier, turn limit, leaving room for unstarted objectives), reporting Level 0 Insufficient Evidence instead of guessing; contaminated answers (after a leaked question) and assisted answers (after a Learning Mode hint) never count as independent; the session ends EvidenceComplete; the report gains per-objective levels and Level 0 notices (GAD-T89); e84a96d Wire the grading pipeline (services, sweeper, report endpoints) and a Grading nav link for owners, admins, instructors, examiners and second reviewers (GAD-T98); 80f225e Scenarios F, G and J through the real grading workflow on LocalDB: agreement combines to 86.8 and waits for approval (the examiner can't approve, the instructor finalizes and publishes); 95 vs 60 opens a mandatory disagreement that blocks approval and publication until a second reviewer documents the resolution; students, examiners and second reviewers are refused amending, scoring, approving or publishing, the grade is untouched and every attempt is an access.denied audit event, while an instructor's amendment goes through (GAD-T101); e0426be Assessment report (Feature 10): final grade, per-objective AI, human and combined scores, verified evidence quotes, knowledge gaps, approval and appeal history, MOCK and preliminary labels; reviewer view at /grading/{id}/report with Markdown and CSV export, student view at /my-results/{id} only after approval and publication, with the appeal form and a Markdown download (GAD-T99); 75567b2 Human grading, combined scoring, reconciliation and final approval (Parts 8-11): grading queue and workspace for Examiners/Teachers (transcript with verified and original text, versions, verification and clarification history, objectives and rubrics, evidence, AI grades with flags and each voter); blind mode hides AI grades and their audit entries until the human submits every objective; HumanObjectiveGrade per objective (adjustments supersede, WasBlind kept); CombinedScoring under the frozen policy and objective weights, a GradeDisagreement per objective, Reconciliation Required blocks finalization (rechecked at approval); side-by-side reconciliation with cause, resolution, resolved scores, second reviewer and recalculation; approve (Finalize record), publish, student appeal, uphold/dismiss or amend; PermissionMatrix on every action with refusals audited; the old release-results path retired so nothing reaches a student without an approval record (GAD-T98); c131f80 Test host never touches live LLM providers (Gadfly:AiMode=mock, so the startup panel probe stays offline); the scripted panel recognizes the v3 objective question, learning-mode and response-analysis prompts (GAD-T104); 08e6689 AI preliminary grading per objective (Part 7, Component F): when a session ends a sweeper creates its FinalGrade and queues grading.ai; the job backfills immutable StudentResponse records from stored answers, holds at Transcript Verification Pending while a response needs a human, freezes the grading policy, derives one objective per examined concept when the exam has none (audited), and grades each objective with the panel: schema-validated levels 0-5 per rubric criterion citing numbered verified responses only (uncited levels refused, citations outside the evidence dropped, quotes kept only if verbatim), scores computed in code (Level-0 criteria left out, not zeroed), median across voters with dissent recorded, misconceptions, ambiguities, review flags, an evidence-criteria confidence category and IsMock from IPanelInfo; AiObjectiveGrade rows, every status move through GradeStatusMachine and audited (GAD-T94); a996dc1 Exhaustive tests: organization-role policies, every role against OrgAdmin/Instructor/Student/Member/Api, the staff MFA rule and its development override, no organization or role refused, examiners and second reviewers are members but not instructors or admins (GAD-T104); f930fd0 Fix the level-0 descriptor test: the descriptor says the examination 'does not provide enough reliable evidence', so the test looks for 'enough reliable evidence' (GAD-T108); e9bbeea Master plan Part 20 scenarios A-J as named tests: A (a correct definition earns no mastery, follow-ups come), B (the initial error and later reasoning both stay in the evidence), C (unclear answers get a Clarify move; drafts that teach are replaced, interpretation-offering clarifications fall back to the student's own words), D (transcript correction keeps the original, scores the verified text, audited), E (a substantive revision is a new response row pointing at the original, with the exam's rule), F (agreement combines and waits for approval), G (95 vs 60 must reconcile, no automatic finalization), H (turn and time limits end without invented certainty; split judges go to a human), I (leaking questions are guarded and replaced), J (unauthorized grade changes are refused and logged as access.denied, cross-organization writes blocked); contamination exclusion waits on GAD-T92 (GAD-T101); 1383e71 Exhaustive tests, part 2: an in-process Gadfly.Server (WebApplicationFactory) on a uniquely named LocalDB database migrated by the app and dropped after the run, with a scripted panel, a manual clock and background services off; tenant filter on every tenant-owned table and isolation across the exam chain, write guard (add/modify/delete/move across organizations, nobody, system), append-only audit and immutable original responses, membership claim parsing; organization directory rules (roles, owner protection, last owner, outside accounts, security-stamp rotation); retention redaction keeps scores and removes words, export content and scoping, erasure; session orchestrator create/resume/window/attempts/quota/consent/ownership/time limit and grace/restart resume/pinned subject/persistence; webhook SSRF table, signature, outbox staging, give-up on bad targets; API key shape, hashing, revocation; usage pricing, cost staging and monthly quota; every mapped route default-deny against the anonymous allow-list; platform API authentication, validation (400/404/409), tenant scoping, launch tokens and the 429 rate limit (GAD-T104); 7cd98b0 Wire the AI panel selection (live / clearly labelled mock / auto), startup panel decision, --seed-demo, the MOCK banner on every layout, and the verification backfill (GAD-T100); a371a49 Exam room confirmation and correction: a pending clarification or transcript check shows inline, one at a time, under the question with the answer as recorded (Yes / correct it / repeat for transcripts; reply, decline or fix a typo instead for meaning), with wording that confirming the transcript is not confirming correctness; after each answer, 'Correct a typo in my last answer' (a transcription correction, original kept, never a penalty) and 'I want to change my answer' (a new response event, shown with the exam's revision rule); time running out during a request submits the answer as recorded for human review (GAD-T88); 1d55911 Verification engine and neutral clarification: after each answer, deterministic checks (incomplete sentence, explicit student request, low speech confidence) plus a schema-checked panel vote decide whether the uncertainty could materially change grading; a clarification is worded by a dedicated prompt that forbids technical content, then must pass a no-new-terms check, a no-interpretation-offered check and the LEAKS/SAFE guard, else a template quoting only the student; voice answers get transcript confirmation first; the orchestrator holds judging until the student replies (pending state persisted, resumes after restart), judges the verified text plus the clarification, sends declined/expired/over-budget ambiguity to human review, and exposes Verification, LastAnswer and Notice on SessionStep with hub methods Clarify, ConfirmTranscript, CorrectAnswer and ReviseAnswer; typo fixes are bounded by deterministic correction rules; exam prompt set v3 (GAD-T87); 94bfb23 Response versioning services: every answer is an immutable StudentResponse (original text, modality, Captured) with transcript version 1 and a capture audit event carrying its timings; transcription corrections add versions and update the verified text, meaning clarifications are stored beside the original, substantive revisions are new response rows pointing at what they revise; every state change goes through VerificationMachine as a ResponseVerification row plus an AuditEvent; earlier answered turns are backfilled as Captured originals by a startup service (AddVerification) (GAD-T86); 69b12b8 Demo tour (Gadfly.Tour): starts a real Gadfly.Server under a renamed exe in mock (or --live) mode against a throwaway LocalDB database (--fresh), seeds the demo, and drives the workflow as real users over HTTP, the platform API and the SessionHub (antiforgery sign-in for every role, MOCK banner, access control, teacher setup, API source processing, student exam with good/ambiguous/typo/revision/I-don't-know answers, end and report, mock labelling, AI and human grading, approval, appeal, report export, review, API results, analytics, audit); every stage asserts against the API and database and prints a checklist, unbuilt features SKIP with their ticket by probing hub methods, routes and tables; exit 1 on any failure; docs/TOUR.md (GAD-T105)) | 84f3cc1 |

reply, decline or fix a typo instead for meaning), with wording that confirming the transcript is not confirming correctness; after each answer, 'Correct a typo in my last answer' (a transcription correction, original kept, never a penalty) and 'I want to change my answer' (a new response event, shown with the exam's revision rule); time running out during a request submits the answer as recorded for human review (GAD-T88); 1d55911 Verification engine and neutral clarification: after each answer, deterministic checks (incomplete sentence, explicit student request, low speech confidence) plus a schema-checked panel vote decide whether the uncertainty could materially change grading; a clarification is worded by a dedicated prompt that forbids technical content, then must pass a no-new-terms check, a no-interpretation-offered check and the LEAKS/SAFE guard, else a template quoting only the student; voice answers get transcript confirmation first; the orchestrator holds judging until the student replies (pending state persisted, resumes after restart), judges the verified text plus the clarification, sends declined/expired/over-budget ambiguity to human review, and exposes Verification, LastAnswer and Notice on SessionStep with hub methods Clarify, ConfirmTranscript, CorrectAnswer and ReviseAnswer; typo fixes are bounded by deterministic correction rules; exam prompt set v3 (GAD-T87); 94bfb23 Response versioning services: every answer is an immutable StudentResponse (original text, modality, Captured) with transcript version 1 and a capture audit event carrying its timings; transcription corrections add versions and update the verified text, meaning clarifications are stored beside the original, substantive revisions are new response rows pointing at what they revise; every state change goes through VerificationMachine as a ResponseVerification row plus an AuditEvent; earlier answered turns are backfilled as Captured originals by a startup service (AddVerification) (GAD-T86); 69b12b8 Demo tour (Gadfly.Tour): starts a real Gadfly.Server under a renamed exe in mock (or --live) mode against a throwaway LocalDB database (--fresh), seeds the demo, and drives the workflow as real users over HTTP, the platform API and the SessionHub (antiforgery sign-in for every role, MOCK banner, access control, teacher setup, API source processing, student exam with good/ambiguous/typo/revision/I-don't-know answers, end and report, mock labelling, AI and human grading, approval, appeal, report export, review, API results, analytics, audit); split judges go to a human), I (leaking questions are guarded and replaced), J (unauthorized grade changes are refused and logged as access.denied, cross-organization writes blocked); contamination exclusion waits on GAD-T92 (GAD-T101); 1383e71 Exhaustive tests, part 2: an in-process Gadfly.Server (WebApplicationFactory) on a uniquely named LocalDB database migrated by the app and dropped after the run, with a scripted panel, a manual clock and background services off; tenant filter on every tenant-owned table and isolation across the exam chain, write guard (add/modify/delete/move across organizations, nobody, system), append-only audit and immutable original responses, membership claim parsing; organization directory rules (roles, owner protection, last owner, outside accounts, security-stamp rotation); retention redaction keeps scores and removes words, export content and scoping, erasure; session orchestrator create/resume/window/attempts/quota/consent/ownership/time limit and grace/restart resume/pinned subject/persistence; webhook SSRF table, signature, outbox staging, give-up on bad targets; API key shape, hashing, revocation; usage pricing, cost staging and monthly quota; every mapped route default-deny against the anonymous allow-list; platform API authentication, validation (400/404/409), tenant scoping, launch tokens and the 429 rate limit (GAD-T104); 7cd98b0 Wire the AI panel selection (live / clearly labelled mock / auto), startup panel decision, --seed-demo, the MOCK banner on every layout, and the verification backfill (GAD-T100); a371a49 Exam room confirmation and correction: a pending clarification or transcript check shows inline, one at a time, under the question with the answer as recorded (Yes / correct it / repeat for transcripts; reply, decline or fix a typo instead for meaning), with wording that confirming the transcript is not confirming correctness; after each answer, 'Correct a typo in my last answer' (a transcription correction, original kept, never a penalty) and 'I want to change my answer' (a new response event, shown with the exam's revision rule); time running out during a request submits the answer as recorded for human review (GAD-T88); 1d55911 Verification engine and neutral clarification: after each answer, deterministic checks (incomplete sentence, explicit student request, low speech confidence) plus a schema-checked panel vote decide whether the uncertainty could materially change grading; a clarification is worded by a dedicated prompt that forbids technical content, then must pass a no-new-terms check, a no-interpretation-offered check and the LEAKS/SAFE guard, else a template quoting only the student; voice answers get transcript confirmation first; the orchestrator holds judging until the student replies (pending state persisted, resumes after restart), judges the verified text plus the clarification, sends declined/expired/over-budget ambiguity to human review, and exposes Verification, LastAnswer and Notice on SessionStep with hub methods Clarify, ConfirmTranscript, CorrectAnswer and ReviseAnswer; typo fixes are bounded by deterministic correction rules; exam prompt set v3 (GAD-T87); 94bfb23 Response versioning services: every answer is an immutable StudentResponse (original text, modality, Captured) with transcript version 1 and a capture audit event carrying its timings; transcription corrections add versions and update the verified text, meaning clarifications are stored beside the original, substantive revisions are new response rows pointing at what they revise; every state change goes through VerificationMachine as a ResponseVerification row plus an AuditEvent; earlier answered turns are backfilled as Captured originals by a startup service (AddVerification) (GAD-T86); 69b12b8 Demo tour (Gadfly.Tour): starts a real Gadfly.Server under a renamed exe in mock (or --live) mode against a throwaway LocalDB database (--fresh), seeds the demo, and drives the workflow as real users over HTTP, the platform API and the SessionHub (antiforgery sign-in for every role, MOCK banner, access control, teacher setup, API source processing, student exam with good/ambiguous/typo/revision/I-don't-know answers, end and report, mock labelling, AI and human grading, approval, appeal, report export, review, API results, analytics, audit); the leak guard fails closed (undecided -> safe fallback) and is reusable on clarifications; drafts that are only a move name or talk about the student are not asked (GAD-T90); 14bc148 Objective-driven examination control: the engine examines learning objectives (key, title, grounding concepts, rubric criteria/dimensions; one implicit objective per concept when an exam has none); per objective a deterministic assessor tracks corroboration (a level needs 2+ independent supporting answers, a conclusion 2+ independent answers), consistency (unconfronted or failed contradictions), transfer and critical reasoning shown, untested misconceptions and remaining uncertainty, and closes it as Sufficient or Inconclusive (per-objective question limit, time with the accommodations multiplier, turn limit, leaving room for unstarted objectives), reporting Level 0 Insufficient Evidence instead of guessing; contaminated answers (after a leaked question) and assisted answers (after a Learning Mode hint) never count as independent; the session ends EvidenceComplete; the report gains per-objective levels and Level 0 notices (GAD-T89); e84a96d Wire the grading pipeline (services, sweeper, report endpoints) and a Grading nav link for owners, admins, instructors, examiners and second reviewers (GAD-T98); 80f225e Scenarios F, G and J through the real grading workflow on LocalDB: agreement combines to 86.8 and waits for approval (the examiner can't approve, the instructor finalizes and publishes); 95 vs 60 opens a mandatory disagreement that blocks approval and publication until a second reviewer documents the resolution; students, examiners and second reviewers are refused amending, scoring, approving or publishing, the grade is untouched and every attempt is an access.denied audit event, while an instructor's amendment goes through (GAD-T101); e0426be Assessment report (Feature 10): final grade, per-objective AI, human and combined scores, verified evidence quotes, knowledge gaps, approval and appeal history, MOCK and preliminary labels; reviewer view at /grading/{id}/report with Markdown and CSV export, student view at /my-results/{id} only after approval and publication, with the appeal form and a Markdown download (GAD-T99); 75567b2 Human grading, combined scoring, reconciliation and final approval (Parts 8-11): grading queue and workspace for Examiners/Teachers (transcript with verified and original text, versions, verification and clarification history, objectives and rubrics, evidence, AI grades with flags and each voter); blind mode hides AI grades and their audit entries until the human submits every objective; HumanObjectiveGrade per objective (adjustments supersede, WasBlind kept); CombinedScoring under the frozen policy and objective weights, a GradeDisagreement per objective, Reconciliation Required blocks finalization (rechecked at approval); side-by-side reconciliation with cause, resolution, resolved scores, second reviewer and recalculation; approve (Finalize record), publish, student appeal, uphold/dismiss or amend; PermissionMatrix on every action with refusals audited; the old release-results path retired so nothing reaches a student without an approval record (GAD-T98); c131f80 Test host never touches live LLM providers (Gadfly:AiMode=mock, so the startup panel probe stays offline); the scripted panel recognizes the v3 objective question, learning-mode and response-analysis prompts (GAD-T104); 08e6689 AI preliminary grading per objective (Part 7, Component F): when a session ends a sweeper creates its FinalGrade and queues grading.ai; the job backfills immutable StudentResponse records from stored answers, holds at Transcript Verification Pending while a response needs a human, freezes the grading policy, derives one objective per examined concept when the exam has none (audited), and grades each objective with the panel: schema-validated levels 0-5 per rubric criterion citing numbered verified responses only (uncited levels refused, citations outside the evidence dropped, quotes kept only if verbatim), scores computed in code (Level-0 criteria left out, not zeroed), median across voters with dissent recorded, misconceptions, ambiguities, review flags, an evidence-criteria confidence category and IsMock from IPanelInfo; AiObjectiveGrade rows, every status move through GradeStatusMachine and audited (GAD-T94); a996dc1 Exhaustive tests: organization-role policies, every role against OrgAdmin/Instructor/Student/Member/Api, the staff MFA rule and its development override, no organization or role refused, examiners and second reviewers are members but not instructors or admins (GAD-T104); f930fd0 Fix the level-0 descriptor test: the descriptor says the examination 'does not provide enough reliable evidence', so the test looks for 'enough reliable evidence' (GAD-T108); e9bbeea Master plan Part 20 scenarios A-J as named tests: A (a correct definition earns no mastery, follow-ups come), B (the initial error and later reasoning both stay in the evidence), C (unclear answers get a Clarify move; drafts that teach are replaced, interpretation-offering clarifications fall back to the student's own words), D (transcript correction keeps the original, scores the verified text, audited), E (a substantive revision is a new response row pointing at the original, with the exam's rule), F (agreement combines and waits for approval), G (95 vs 60 must reconcile, no automatic finalization), H (turn and time limits end without invented certainty; split judges go to a human), I (leaking questions are guarded and replaced), J (unauthorized grade changes are refused and logged as access.denied, cross-organization writes blocked); contamination exclusion waits on GAD-T92 (GAD-T101); 1383e71 Exhaustive tests, part 2: an in-process Gadfly.Server (WebApplicationFactory) on a uniquely named LocalDB database migrated by the app and dropped after the run, with a scripted panel, a manual clock and background services off; tenant filter on every tenant-owned table and isolation across the exam chain, write guard (add/modify/delete/move across organizations, nobody, system), append-only audit and immutable original responses, membership claim parsing; organization directory rules (roles, owner protection, last owner, outside accounts, security-stamp rotation); retention redaction keeps scores and removes words, export content and scoping, erasure; session orchestrator create/resume/window/attempts/quota/consent/ownership/time limit and grace/restart resume/pinned subject/persistence; webhook SSRF table, signature, outbox staging, give-up on bad targets; API key shape, hashing, revocation; usage pricing, cost staging and monthly quota; every mapped route default-deny against the anonymous allow-list; platform API authentication, validation (400/404/409), tenant scoping, launch tokens and the 429 rate limit (GAD-T104); 7cd98b0 Wire the AI panel selection (live / clearly labelled mock / auto), startup panel decision, --seed-demo, the MOCK banner on every layout, and the verification backfill (GAD-T100); a371a49 Exam room confirmation and correction: a pending clarification or transcript check shows inline, one at a time, under the question with the answer as recorded (Yes / correct it / repeat for transcripts; reply, decline or fix a typo instead for meaning), with wording that confirming the transcript is not confirming correctness; after each answer, 'Correct a typo in my last answer' (a transcription correction, original kept, never a penalty) and 'I want to change my answer' (a new response event, shown with the exam's revision rule); time running out during a request submits the answer as recorded for human review (GAD-T88); 1d55911 Verification engine and neutral clarification: after each answer, deterministic checks (incomplete sentence, explicit student request, low speech confidence) plus a schema-checked panel vote decide whether the uncertainty could materially change grading; a clarification is worded by a dedicated prompt that forbids technical content, then must pass a no-new-terms check, a no-interpretation-offered check and the LEAKS/SAFE guard, else a template quoting only the student; voice answers get transcript confirmation first; the orchestrator holds judging until the student replies (pending state persisted, resumes after restart), judges the verified text plus the clarification, sends declined/expired/over-budget ambiguity to human review, and exposes Verification, LastAnswer and Notice on SessionStep with hub methods Clarify, ConfirmTranscript, CorrectAnswer and ReviseAnswer; typo fixes are bounded by deterministic correction rules; exam prompt set v3 (GAD-T87); 94bfb23 Response versioning services: every answer is an immutable StudentResponse (original text, modality, Captured) with transcript version 1 and a capture audit event carrying its timings; transcription corrections add versions and update the verified text, meaning clarifications are stored beside the original, substantive revisions are new response rows pointing at what they revise; every state change goes through VerificationMachine as a ResponseVerification row plus an AuditEvent; earlier answered turns are backfilled as Captured originals by a startup service (AddVerification) (GAD-T86); 69b12b8 Demo tour (Gadfly.Tour): starts a real Gadfly.Server under a renamed exe in mock (or --live) mode against a throwaway LocalDB database (--fresh), seeds the demo, and drives the workflow as real users over HTTP, the platform API and the SessionHub (antiforgery sign-in for every role, MOCK banner, access control, teacher setup, API source processing, student exam with good/ambiguous/typo/revision/I-don't-know answers, end and report, mock labelling, AI and human grading, approval, appeal, report export, review, API results, analytics, audit); every stage asserts against the API and database and prints a checklist, unbuilt features SKIP with their ticket by probing hub methods, routes and tables; exit 1 on any failure; docs/TOUR.md (GAD-T105)) | bce163c |

92f679a Questioning strategies A-H: CausalReasoning, ScenarioVariation, AssumptionTesting and IndependentExplanation join conceptual probing, counterexample, transfer and contradiction; the planner picks by information value (the move whose answer best separates the corroborated level, the tentative top and the plausible ceiling, with misconception, dimension-gap, repetition and difficulty terms) and records why; e0426be Assessment report (Feature 10): final grade, per-objective AI, human and combined scores, verified evidence quotes, knowledge gaps, approval and appeal history, MOCK and preliminary labels; reviewer view at /grading/{id}/report with Markdown and CSV export, student view at /my-results/{id} only after approval and publication, with the appeal form and a Markdown download (GAD-T99); 75567b2 Human grading, combined scoring, reconciliation and final approval (Parts 8-11): grading queue and workspace for Examiners/Teachers (transcript with verified and original text, versions, verification and clarification history, objectives and rubrics, evidence, AI grades with flags and each voter); blind mode hides AI grades and their audit entries until the human submits every objective; HumanObjectiveGrade per objective (adjustments supersede, WasBlind kept); CombinedScoring under the frozen policy and objective weights, a GradeDisagreement per objective, Reconciliation Required blocks finalization (rechecked at approval); side-by-side reconciliation with cause, resolution, resolved scores, second reviewer and recalculation; approve (Finalize record), publish, student appeal, uphold/dismiss or amend; PermissionMatrix on every action with refusals audited; the old release-results path retired so nothing reaches a student without an approval record (GAD-T98); c131f80 Test host never touches live LLM providers (Gadfly:AiMode=mock, so the startup panel probe stays offline); the scripted panel recognizes the v3 objective question, learning-mode and response-analysis prompts (GAD-T104); 08e6689 AI preliminary grading per objective (Part 7, Component F): when a session ends a sweeper creates its FinalGrade and queues grading.ai; the job backfills immutable StudentResponse records from stored answers, holds at Transcript Verification Pending while a response needs a human, freezes the grading policy, derives one objective per examined concept when the exam has none (audited), and grades each objective with the panel: schema-validated levels 0-5 per rubric criterion citing numbered verified responses only (uncited levels refused, citations outside the evidence dropped, quotes kept only if verbatim), scores computed in code (Level-0 criteria left out, not zeroed), median across voters with dissent recorded, misconceptions, ambiguities, review flags, an evidence-criteria confidence category and IsMock from IPanelInfo; AiObjectiveGrade rows, every status move through GradeStatusMachine and audited (GAD-T94); a996dc1 Exhaustive tests: organization-role policies, every role against OrgAdmin/Instructor/Student/Member/Api, the staff MFA rule and its development override, no organization or role refused, examiners and second reviewers are members but not instructors or admins (GAD-T104); f930fd0 Fix the level-0 descriptor test: the descriptor says the examination 'does not provide enough reliable evidence', so the test looks for 'enough reliable evidence' (GAD-T108); e9bbeea Master plan Part 20 scenarios A-J as named tests: A (a correct definition earns no mastery, follow-ups come), B (the initial error and later reasoning both stay in the evidence), C (unclear answers get a Clarify move; drafts that teach are replaced, interpretation-offering clarifications fall back to the student's own words), D (transcript correction keeps the original, scores the verified text, audited), E (a substantive revision is a new response row pointing at the original, with the exam's rule), F (agreement combines and waits for approval), G (95 vs 60 must reconcile, no automatic finalization), H (turn and time limits end without invented certainty; split judges go to a human), I (leaking questions are guarded and replaced), J (unauthorized grade changes are refused and logged as access.denied, cross-organization writes blocked); contamination exclusion waits on GAD-T92 (GAD-T101); 1383e71 Exhaustive tests, part 2: an in-process Gadfly.Server (WebApplicationFactory) on a uniquely named LocalDB database migrated by the app and dropped after the run, with a scripted panel, a manual clock and background services off; tenant filter on every tenant-owned table and isolation across the exam chain, write guard (add/modify/delete/move across organizations, nobody, system), append-only audit and immutable original responses, membership claim parsing; organization directory rules (roles, owner protection, last owner, outside accounts, security-stamp rotation); retention redaction keeps scores and removes words, export content and scoping, erasure; session orchestrator create/resume/window/attempts/quota/consent/ownership/time limit and grace/restart resume/pinned subject/persistence; webhook SSRF table, signature, outbox staging, give-up on bad targets; API key shape, hashing, revocation; usage pricing, cost staging and monthly quota; every mapped route default-deny against the anonymous allow-list; platform API authentication, validation (400/404/409), tenant scoping, launch tokens and the 429 rate limit (GAD-T104); 7cd98b0 Wire the AI panel selection (live / clearly labelled mock / auto), startup panel decision, --seed-demo, the MOCK banner on every layout, and the verification backfill (GAD-T100); a371a49 Exam room confirmation and correction: a pending clarification or transcript check shows inline, one at a time, under the question with the answer as recorded (Yes / correct it / repeat for transcripts; reply, decline or fix a typo instead for meaning), with wording that confirming the transcript is not confirming correctness; after each answer, 'Correct a typo in my last answer' (a transcription correction, original kept, never a penalty) and 'I want to change my answer' (a new response event, shown with the exam's revision rule); time running out during a request submits the answer as recorded for human review (GAD-T88); 1d55911 Verification engine and neutral clarification: after each answer, deterministic checks (incomplete sentence, explicit student request, low speech confidence) plus a schema-checked panel vote decide whether the uncertainty could materially change grading; a clarification is worded by a dedicated prompt that forbids technical content, then must pass a no-new-terms check, a no-interpretation-offered check and the LEAKS/SAFE guard, else a template quoting only the student; voice answers get transcript confirmation first; the orchestrator holds judging until the student replies (pending state persisted, resumes after restart), judges the verified text plus the clarification, sends declined/expired/over-budget ambiguity to human review, and exposes Verification, LastAnswer and Notice on SessionStep with hub methods Clarify, ConfirmTranscript, CorrectAnswer and ReviseAnswer; typo fixes are bounded by deterministic correction rules; exam prompt set v3 (GAD-T87); 94bfb23 Response versioning services: every answer is an immutable StudentResponse (original text, modality, Captured) with transcript version 1 and a capture audit event carrying its timings; transcription corrections add versions and update the verified text, meaning clarifications are stored beside the original, substantive revisions are new response rows pointing at what they revise; every state change goes through VerificationMachine as a ResponseVerification row plus an AuditEvent; earlier answered turns are backfilled as Captured originals by a startup service (AddVerification) (GAD-T86); 69b12b8 Demo tour (Gadfly.Tour): starts a real Gadfly.Server under a renamed exe in mock (or --live) mode against a throwaway LocalDB database (--fresh), seeds the demo, and drives the workflow as real users over HTTP, the platform API and the SessionHub (antiforgery sign-in for every role, MOCK banner, access control, teacher setup, API source processing, student exam with good/ambiguous/typo/revision/I-don't-know answers, end and report, mock labelling, AI and human grading, approval, appeal, report export, review, API results, analytics, audit); every stage asserts against the API and database and prints a checklist, unbuilt features SKIP with their ticket by probing hub methods, routes and tables; exit 1 on any failure; docs/TOUR.md (GAD-T105)) | 84f3cc1 |

92f679a Questioning strategies A-H: CausalReasoning, ScenarioVariation, AssumptionTesting and IndependentExplanation join conceptual probing, counterexample, transfer and contradiction; the planner picks by information value (the move whose answer best separates the corroborated level, the tentative top and the plausible ceiling, with misconception, dimension-gap, repetition and difficulty terms) and records why; the question prompt (ExamPromptsV3, merged as the next prompt-set version until folded into ExamPrompts) describes all eight and forbids teaching in examination mode; Learning Mode hints and guided explanations get their own prompt; the leak guard fails closed (undecided -> safe fallback) and is reusable on clarifications; drafts that are only a move name or talk about the student are not asked (GAD-T90); 14bc148 Objective-driven examination control: the engine examines learning objectives (key, title, grounding concepts, rubric criteria/dimensions; one implicit objective per concept when an exam has none); per objective a deterministic assessor tracks corroboration (a level needs 2+ independent supporting answers, a conclusion 2+ independent answers), consistency (unconfronted or failed contradictions), transfer and critical reasoning shown, untested misconceptions and remaining uncertainty, and closes it as Sufficient or Inconclusive (per-objective question limit, time with the accommodations multiplier, turn limit, leaving room for unstarted objectives), reporting Level 0 Insufficient Evidence instead of guessing; contaminated answers (after a leaked question) and assisted answers (after a Learning Mode hint) never count as independent; the session ends EvidenceComplete; the report gains per-objective levels and Level 0 notices (GAD-T89); 95 vs 60 opens a mandatory disagreement that blocks approval and publication until a second reviewer documents the resolution; students, examiners and second reviewers are refused amending, scoring, approving or publishing, the grade is untouched and every attempt is an access.denied audit event, while an instructor's amendment goes through (GAD-T101); e0426be Assessment report (Feature 10): final grade, per-objective AI, human and combined scores, verified evidence quotes, knowledge gaps, approval and appeal history, MOCK and preliminary labels; reviewer view at /grading/{id}/report with Markdown and CSV export, student view at /my-results/{id} only after approval and publication, with the appeal form and a Markdown download (GAD-T99); 75567b2 Human grading, combined scoring, reconciliation and final approval (Parts 8-11): grading queue and workspace for Examiners/Teachers (transcript with verified and original text, versions, verification and clarification history, objectives and rubrics, evidence, AI grades with flags and each voter); blind mode hides AI grades and their audit entries until the human submits every objective; HumanObjectiveGrade per objective (adjustments supersede, WasBlind kept); CombinedScoring under the frozen policy and objective weights, a GradeDisagreement per objective, Reconciliation Required blocks finalization (rechecked at approval); side-by-side reconciliation with cause, resolution, resolved scores, second reviewer and recalculation; approve (Finalize record), publish, student appeal, uphold/dismiss or amend; PermissionMatrix on every action with refusals audited; the old release-results path retired so nothing reaches a student without an approval record (GAD-T98); c131f80 Test host never touches live LLM providers (Gadfly:AiMode=mock, so the startup panel probe stays offline); the scripted panel recognizes the v3 objective question, learning-mode and response-analysis prompts (GAD-T104); 08e6689 AI preliminary grading per objective (Part 7, Component F): when a session ends a sweeper creates its FinalGrade and queues grading.ai; AiObjectiveGrade rows, every status move through GradeStatusMachine and audited (GAD-T94); a996dc1 Exhaustive tests: organization-role policies, every role against OrgAdmin/Instructor/Student/Member/Api, the staff MFA rule and its development override, no organization or role refused, examiners and second reviewers are members but not instructors or admins (GAD-T104); f930fd0 Fix the level-0 descriptor test: the descriptor says the examination 'does not provide enough reliable evidence', so the test looks for 'enough reliable evidence' (GAD-T108); e9bbeea Master plan Part 20 scenarios A-J as named tests: A (a correct definition earns no mastery, follow-ups come), B (the initial error and later reasoning both stay in the evidence), C (unclear answers get a Clarify move; drafts that teach are replaced, interpretation-offering clarifications fall back to the student's own words), D (transcript correction keeps the original, scores the verified text, audited), E (a substantive revision is a new response row pointing at the original, with the exam's rule), F (agreement combines and waits for approval), G (95 vs 60 must reconcile, no automatic finalization), H (turn and time limits end without invented certainty; 1383e71 Exhaustive tests, part 2: an in-process Gadfly.Server (WebApplicationFactory) on a uniquely named LocalDB database migrated by the app and dropped after the run, with a scripted panel, a manual clock and background services off; tenant filter on every tenant-owned table and isolation across the exam chain, write guard (add/modify/delete/move across organizations, nobody, system), append-only audit and immutable original responses, membership claim parsing; organization directory rules (roles, owner protection, last owner, outside accounts, security-stamp rotation); retention redaction keeps scores and removes words, export content and scoping, erasure; session orchestrator create/resume/window/attempts/quota/consent/ownership/time limit and grace/restart resume/pinned subject/persistence; webhook SSRF table, signature, outbox staging, give-up on bad targets; API key shape, hashing, revocation; usage pricing, cost staging and monthly quota; every mapped route default-deny against the anonymous allow-list; platform API authentication, validation (400/404/409), tenant scoping, launch tokens and the 429 rate limit (GAD-T104); 7cd98b0 Wire the AI panel selection (live / clearly labelled mock / auto), startup panel decision, --seed-demo, the MOCK banner on every layout, and the verification backfill (GAD-T100); a371a49 Exam room confirmation and correction: a pending clarification or transcript check shows inline, one at a time, under the question with the answer as recorded (Yes / correct it / repeat for transcripts; reply, decline or fix a typo instead for meaning), with wording that confirming the transcript is not confirming correctness; after each answer, 'Correct a typo in my last answer' (a transcription correction, original kept, never a penalty) and 'I want to change my answer' (a new response event, shown with the exam's revision rule); time running out during a request submits the answer as recorded for human review (GAD-T88); 1d55911 Verification engine and neutral clarification: after each answer, deterministic checks (incomplete sentence, explicit student request, low speech confidence) plus a schema-checked panel vote decide whether the uncertainty could materially change grading; a clarification is worded by a dedicated prompt that forbids technical content, then must pass a no-new-terms check, a no-interpretation-offered check and the LEAKS/SAFE guard, else a template quoting only the student; voice answers get transcript confirmation first; the orchestrator holds judging until the student replies (pending state persisted, resumes after restart), judges the verified text plus the clarification, sends declined/expired/over-budget ambiguity to human review, and exposes Verification, LastAnswer and Notice on SessionStep with hub methods Clarify, ConfirmTranscript, CorrectAnswer and ReviseAnswer; typo fixes are bounded by deterministic correction rules; exam prompt set v3 (GAD-T87); 94bfb23 Response versioning services: every answer is an immutable StudentResponse (original text, modality, Captured) with transcript version 1 and a capture audit event carrying its timings; transcription corrections add versions and update the verified text, meaning clarifications are stored beside the original, substantive revisions are new response rows pointing at what they revise; every state change goes through VerificationMachine as a ResponseVerification row plus an AuditEvent; earlier answered turns are backfilled as Captured originals by a startup service (AddVerification) (GAD-T86); 69b12b8 Demo tour (Gadfly.Tour): starts a real Gadfly.Server under a renamed exe in mock (or --live) mode against a throwaway LocalDB database (--fresh), seeds the demo, and drives the workflow as real users over HTTP, the platform API and the SessionHub (antiforgery sign-in for every role, MOCK banner, access control, teacher setup, API source processing, student exam with good/ambiguous/typo/revision/I-don't-know answers, end and report, mock labelling, AI and human grading, approval, appeal, report export, review, API results, analytics, audit);
